title: AI Governance InternationaL Evaluation Index (AGILE Index) 2025

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the gender ratio of active AI researchers using bibliometric data (DBLP) and assessing national gender gaps in internet usage and programming skills using demographic survey data.
Assessing the digital inclusion and access of older demographics by measuring the share of individuals aged 55-74 who use the internet.
Evaluating the digital inclusion of vulnerable social groups by measuring the share of internet users from households in the lowest income quintile.
